title: Staying with Gene Krupa, then back to Chicago
summary: Returning to New York, they stay with Gene Krupa for several days, then go to Chicago.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Oh really? Well let's talk a little bit about him then. Talk about staying with him. (LAUGHTER).

I always call him Genie with the light brown teeth. (LAUGHTER). Kid him, you know. A great guy. So we stayed with Gene for four or five days. And then we went to Washington DC and then back to Chicago. And that's when we started playing. I said, look honey, let's take off three or four months. You know, the War is over and I've been going for three years now, you know. And I had quite a bit of money too. (LAUGHTER).
